categories.main_business_segments: Hezong Science & Technology operates primarily in two segments: the power sector and lithium battery cathode materials. The power segment focuses on the research, manufacturing, sales, and engineering services of distribution, transformation, and control equipment for power grids, including products like ring main units, switch cabinets, pole-mounted switches, box-type substations, transformers, and intelligent distribution terminals. The lithium battery cathode materials segment, led by its controlling subsidiary Hunan Yacheng, specializes in the R&D, production, and sales of lithium battery cathode precursors such as lithium iron phosphate, cobalt oxides, and cobalt hydroxide, serving mainly the new energy vehicle and energy storage markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including ammonium method for lithium iron phosphate production, high-pressure leaching wet smelting for cobalt and nickel sulfate production, and proprietary processes for doped cobalt oxides and hydroxides. It integrates product design, computer simulation, composite insulation, and pressure vessel technologies in power equipment manufacturing. The lithium materials segment emphasizes high-density, uniform particle size, and doping technologies to enhance battery performance. The company also invests in digital and flexible power electronics technologies to support smart grid and new energy systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and regional power grid companies such as State Grid and Southern Grid, industrial and commercial enterprises, rail transit, data centers, petrochemical sectors, and overseas projects for the power segment. The lithium battery materials segment serves major lithium battery manufacturers for new energy vehicles, energy storage systems, and 3C electronics, including well-known clients like BYD, Samsung SDI, and CATL. The company also targets emerging markets in distributed energy, microgrids, and smart cities.
categories.geographic_coverage: Hezong operates mainly within mainland China, covering 29 provinces and autonomous regions with strong market presence in Guangdong, Jiangsu, Shandong, Henan, and Hebei. It also has overseas operations including subsidiaries in Indonesia and Hong Kong, and exports lithium battery materials internationally. The company’s power equipment and engineering services extend to domestic and select international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. In the power sector, it manufactures and supplies distribution and control equipment and provides engineering design and EPC services. In the lithium battery materials sector, it produces cathode precursor materials and related chemical products, supplying to battery manufacturers. It also engages in raw material processing for cobalt and nickel products, supporting upstream supply for battery materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing R&D capabilities in smart grid technologies, flexible power electronics, and high-performance lithium battery materials. The company focuses on product innovation such as integrated energy storage systems, high-density lithium iron phosphate, doped cobalt oxides, and nanomaterial additives. It pursues collaborations with universities and research institutes to advance technology and improve production efficiency. Cost control, market expansion, and certification for new customers are also key R&D and strategic initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of power distribution and control equipment, lithium battery cathode materials, and related engineering services. The company participates in government and utility tenders and contracts, selling products and providing EPC and design services. It also sells industrial metals like cobalt and nickel products. Sales are predominantly direct to large institutional customers, with some export sales in the lithium materials segment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hezong is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the power distribution equipment sector with top rankings in ring main units and transformers. In lithium battery materials, it is a recognized supplier of lithium iron phosphate precursors and cobalt compounds, competing with other major Chinese and international battery material producers. The company faces intense competition due to industry overcapacity and price pressures but leverages its integrated service capabilities and R&D strengths to maintain market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.65 billion, a 10.33% decline from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 631 million. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 5.42 billion, down 44% year-over-year, reflecting asset impairments and restructuring. Despite losses, cash flow from operations improved significantly. The company’s financial profile shows challenges due to market price declines in lithium materials and operational difficulties in some subsidiaries, but it continues to invest in R&D and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hezong emphasizes its integrated one-stop solutions combining product manufacturing, engineering design, and EPC services in the power sector, offering reliable, high-performance, and customized distribution equipment. In lithium battery materials, it highlights advanced production technologies, stable product quality, and strong customer certification credentials. The company’s focus on innovation, cost optimization, and comprehensive service capabilities aims to deliver superior value and competitive differentiation in rapidly evolving energy and new materials markets.
